nodes.description: Mapping in Brainz storing the last reward accrual timestamp for each staked Bit Monster tokenId.
Private pseudo-random state variable in Brainz used to decide staking outcomes.
Private pseudo-random state variable in Mutator used for rerolls and mutations.
Reference to the Brainz token contract that Mutator calls to burn Brainz.
Reference to the BitMonsters NFT contract used by addon contracts.
Total supply of Brainz ERC20 tokens, modified by _mint and _burn.
Per-address Brainz balance mapping.
External function looping over the caller's Bit Monsters, accruing rewards, refreshing stake timestamps and minting Brainz.
External function that burns or mints Brainz from the caller depending on a pseudo-random coin flip.
View function computing pending Brainz as rewardRate * elapsed days based on block.timestamp.
Admin-only function recording block.timestamp for a tokenId to start reward accrual.
Pure function computing a Bit Monster's daily reward rate from its attributes.
Admin-only mint of Brainz to an arbitrary address.
Admin-only burn of Brainz from an arbitrary address.
External ownsToken-guarded function that burns Brainz and rerolls a single trait of a Bit Monster.
External ownsToken-guarded function that burns Brainz and rerolls all traits of a Bit Monster.
External function that burns Brainz and probabilistically copies a donor trait onto a recipient using pseudo-randomness.
Library function hashing new entropy into the Rng state and returning a uint256.
Library function returning a random value in [min,max] via modulo of generate(Rng).
Library function deriving entropy from block.coinbase and msg.sender, i.e. weak on-chain randomness.
Library function creating a new Rng seeded with getEntropy().
Internal OpenZeppelin ERC20 mint increasing _totalSupply and _balances.
Internal OpenZeppelin ERC20 burn decreasing _totalSupply and _balances.
Modifier gating privileged functions by checking bitMonsters.isAdmin(msg.sender).
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, reward accounting and randomness seeding.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for reward accrual, staking time and re-registration.
Arithmetic update tokenIdToTimestamp[tokenId] = block.timestamp - ((block.timestamp - old) % 86400).
Mints the accumulated 'total' rewards to msg.sender; accounting depends on timestamps and external NFT reads.
Integer arithmetic (block.timestamp - tokenIdToTimestamp)/86400 is timestamp dependent and truncating.
Mints (count - count/10)*1 ether on a winning coin flip; count arithmetic.
Burns count*1 ether from the caller when the coin flip loses.
The win/lose outcome is decided by rng.generate(0,1), predictable from public block data.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.coinbase, msg.sender)) yields miner/sender-influenced randomness.
External call brainz.adminBurn(msg.sender, brainzCount) performed before NFT state updates.
External calls to bitMonsters.setBitMonster for donor and recipient after random decisions.
Success check rn.generate(1, brainzCount + 3) <= brainzCount with user-supplied brainzCount.
External call brainz.adminBurn(msg.sender, brainzCount) in rerollTrait before NFT updates.
Number of Brainz the caller stakes.
Token id whose pending rewards are computed.
Token id being registered for staking.
Recipient address for admin mint.
Number of Brainz to mint, multiplied by 1 ether.
Token id of the donor Bit Monster.
Token id of the recipient Bit Monster.
Trait selected for mutation.
Amount of Brainz paid and used as the success weight.
Inclusive minimum of the random range.
Inclusive maximum of the random range.
Accumulated rewards that will be minted.
Per-token reward amount returned by calculateRewards.
Token id obtained from tokenOfOwnerByIndex inside the loop.
Elapsed staking days used to multiply the reward rate.
Memory copy of the Rng state used for the coin flip.
Memory copy of the donor Bit Monster.
Memory copy of the recipient Bit Monster.

edges.reason: onlyAdmin reads msg.sender when calling bitMonsters.isAdmin.
adminMint is restricted to addresses whitelisted as admins using msg.sender.
adminBurn is restricted to addresses whitelisted as admins using msg.sender.
onlyAdmin modifier gates the adminMint function.
onlyAdmin modifier gates the adminBurn function.
claimBrainz uses msg.sender as the reward owner and mint target.
stake uses msg.sender for balance checks and mint/burn.
mutate relies on ownsToken(msg.sender) checks for donor and recipient.
getEntropy mixes msg.sender into the randomness seed.
claimBrainz reward accrual depends on block.timestamp.
calculateRewards depends on block.timestamp.
register stores block.timestamp as the staking start time.
claimBrainz performs timestamp modulo arithmetic on tokenIdToTimestamp.
claimBrainz mints the accumulated rewards to the caller.
claimBrainz calls calculateRewards for each owned token.
claimBrainz mints new Brainz tokens via _mint.
claimBrainz reads and writes tokenIdToTimestamp.
calculateRewards reads tokenIdToTimestamp.
calculateRewards computes the elapsed day count.
calculateRewards calls rewardRate for the token's rate.
register writes tokenIdToTimestamp.
stake calls RngLibrary.generate(min,max).
stake outcome depends on predictable pseudo-randomness.
stake mints a reward on the winning branch.
stake burns the stake on the losing branch.
stake mints Brainz via _mint.
stake burns Brainz via _burn.
stake reads and writes the Brainz rng state.
generateRange delegates to generate(Rng).
min parameter bounds the random range.
max parameter bounds the random range.
generate(Rng) hashes getEntropy() into the state.
getEntropy hashes block.coinbase and msg.sender, giving weak randomness.
newRng seeds the initial state from getEntropy.
mutate performs an external brainz.adminBurn call before mutating NFT state.
mutate performs external bitMonsters.setBitMonster calls after random decisions.
mutate computes the success probability with brainzCount arithmetic.
mutate calls brainz.adminBurn which requires admin rights on Brainz.
mutate reads and writes Bit Monsters via the bitMonsters reference.
mutate reads the Mutator.brainz reference.
mutate reads and writes the Mutator rng state.
rerollTrait performs an external brainz.adminBurn call before updating NFT state.
rerollTrait calls brainz.adminBurn.
rerollTrait reads the Mutator.brainz reference.
rerollTrait reads and writes the Mutator rng state.
rerollAll calls brainz.adminBurn.
rerollAll reads and writes the Mutator rng state.
adminMint mints count*1 ether via _mint.
adminBurn burns count*1 ether via _burn.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases the target balance in _balances.
claimBrainz queries bitMonsters.balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
mutate queries bitMonsters.getBitMonster and setBitMonster.
stake.count parameter drives the stake mint/burn amount.
calculateRewards.tokenId parameter selects the tracked monster.
register.tokenId parameter selects the monster to register.
adminMint.addr parameter is the mint recipient.
adminMint.count parameter scales the minted amount.
mutate.donorId parameter selects the donor NFT.
mutate.recipientId parameter selects the recipient NFT.
mutate.trait parameter selects which trait is mutated.
mutate.brainzCount parameter sets the paid amount and success weight.
claimBrainz.total accumulated rewards are minted.
claimBrainz.rewards per-token rewards are summed into the mint amount.
claimBrainz.tokenId local indexes the timestamp update and reward lookup.
calculateRewards.nDays local is the computed elapsed days.
stake.rn local memory copy produces the coin flip.
mutate.donor local is written back via setBitMonster.
mutate.recipient local is written back via setBitMonster.
